key_findings: P14 must not run without explicit opt-in.
Missing metrics need reason and impact.
Existing layers and surfaces are available.
Root commit SHA needed visible HTML exposure.

findings.description: The required L10 final gate did not exist at design time.
Missing metric impact was not enforced at design time.
evidence: metric_catalog missing-like records had reasons but no impact

proposed_harness.acceptance: Writes schema-valid final_audit_report.json and fails on blocking full-chain invariant violations.

proposed_harness.name: schemas/artifact/final_audit_report.schema.json
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validates final audit source artifacts, reports, invariants, P14 boundary, and missing metric impacts.

proposed_harness.name: tests/final_audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: Covers PASS path and dry-run-real, missing-impact, and report-source regressions.

acceptance_criteria: P14 not run or counted as real.
Every missing-like metric has reason and impact.
Final HTML exposes root commit SHA and source artifacts.
risks: A superficial final gate could miss cross-artifact inconsistencies.
P14 dry-run artifacts could be mistaken for real coverage.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not use rendered reports as metric source truth.
notes: Requirements are clear; final gate, schema, tests, impact propagation, and commit visibility are required.
